First-Year Essay Questions for 2026-27

All applicants

All applicants must answer this question in 300 words or fewer:

Tell us about a community you belong to and the role you play in it.

College of Engineering

Applicants to the College of Engineering must also answer the following in 200 words or fewer.

Describe something you built, fixed, or designed, and what you would change about it now.

School of Nursing

Applicants to the School of Nursing must also respond in 250 words or fewer.

What experiences have led you to choose nursing as a career?
